properties.description: Pins the class behind fact:root-cause-the-reasoning-walk-never-reaches-a-claim-only-an-objection-points-to-2026-10-18 over the MCP surface. On proof trial rung 2 and rung 1, imported from their committed fixtures, reasoning_report with no claim, read through all its pages, walks every node that has a statement_reading or a proof_status, and both ends of every opposing CONTRADICTS. Named: rung 2's req:conj-h-unique-factorization and req:conj-h-euclid, rung 1's req:conjecture-euler-polynomial. Read again in small pages, every claim comes back once and the summary lists are the whole walk's on every page. A hand-built bare conjecture refuted by a bare counterexample (neither concluded nor a premise) and an open conjecture nothing touches are both read, and the walk starts from the refuted claim, not from the counterexample.
properties.name: the_whole_reasoning_walk_reaches_every_claim.rs — the whole-design reasoning_report reads every claim, refuted conjectures included, on both proof trials
